acceptance.requirement: From a blank workbench, the user and embedded AI compose an original chart-free view from authorized data and actions. Locally edit it, refresh its data, inspect evidence, undo and reopen it without a product rebuild. Recover the accepted view after a failed draft. Demonstrate the published cases and an unseen authoring request on a frozen release package.
A clean Windows x64 system without Python/Node can install and run simulated mode
Open all three synthetic instruments and switch timeframes; the UI explicitly displays simulated
After disconnecting the market worker, its status is visible and recovery uses bounded retries without duplicate subscriptions
Mock AI creates a declarative abnormal-volatility indicator based on user requirements; preview, acceptance, removal, and undo all complete
AI tools and user operations use the same registry; direct requests for unauthorized operations are rejected
For new work, existing confirmations become invalid when parameters, the code hash or a bound workspace or selection revision changes
Indicator timeouts, exceptions, and invalid output neither interrupt market data nor overwrite accepted indicators
Closing and reopening restores the workspace and indicator versions without re-executing previous AI tasks
Logs, the database, and worker environments contain no plaintext credentials
No worker child processes remain alive after application shutdown
Generated types have no uncommitted differences; schemas and validation in all three languages are consistent

AI operations show their target, preview or progress and actual outcome in the affected view. Confirmation, denial, failure and cancellation remain visible.
An explicitly enabled real voice session supports spoken discussion, interruption and text follow-up under the same operation permissions. A denied or interrupted request has an observable outcome.

Starting from a buy question, compare evidence, revise a challenged premise, and perform only a separately authorized workspace change. Reopen a user-saved decision and distinguish the original rationale from the later outcome.

Choose a provider and model independently of market data. Show verified capabilities, destination and applicable charges, handle an unsupported feature, and exercise a configured model on an evidence-based discussion.

An opted-in local MCP client reads the selected chart and, with a write grant, adds a reversible annotation to the same open workspace. The UI attributes the action. Denied, stale and revoked requests preserve the workspace and respect output permissions.
Observe Codex CLI and one compatible desktop AI client separately reading the open chart and applying a scoped annotation. Verify the visible result and undo on each supported test host.

Test, save, refresh and disconnect independently with a controlled connector. Verify optional ScopeHub data services are labeled separately. Opt in to the read-only saved folder and approve a versioned rule. Publish compatible appends once across notifications, retry and restart. Stage a historical correction or removal for review, stop publication after pause or revocation, and require explicit rebind before using a replacement root. Reopen the prior entitled revision.

Profile, map, preview and verify CSV and Parquet market fixtures offline. Inspect typed daily and auction records, leading-zero symbols, units, missing values and adjustment-factor provenance. Reject publication under a stale rule and reproduce an analysis from the retained source and rule revisions.

Select the public owner-earnings analysis method and run it on dated evidence. Show its author, source and version, as-of inputs, calculations, counterevidence and gaps. Repeat from the same evidence and verify that selecting the method grants no additional tool or data access.

Use the desktop in English or Simplified Chinese, follow the system language or save an override, and change languages with a chart and a draft open. Preserve the selected market evidence and original user content across the change.

desktop_performance.profile: Record CPU/RAM/Windows/WebView2 versions; release build; 10000 bars; one chart; mock stream at 10 updates/s
desktop_performance.memory_policy: Sample total process-tree private bytes once per minute for 120 minutes. Discard the first 10 samples and compare the medians of eleven consecutive ten-sample windows. Growth above the greater of 32 MiB or 10 percent of the first median, with at least eight of ten window-to-window increases, fails. Growth above that threshold with fewer increases is inconclusive and requires investigation and another retained run. A complete series below or at the threshold passes this bounded observation.
desktop_performance.measurement: Use the identified release installer and record Windows family/build, WebView2, CPU, RAM, display scale and refresh rate. Run the same fixed 10,000-bar dataset in a fresh app process for 20 cold chart loads and in one reused process for 20 warm loads. Report each group separately. Use nearest-rank p95 from user request to first presented frame containing all requested bars. Both groups must meet the first-chart limit.
desktop_performance.updates: For 120 minutes at 10 ordered updates per second measure publication to the first presented chart frame carrying that position or a later coalesced position. Attribute every update to a visible frame. All 72,000 positions and the final closed bar must be accounted for. Missing samples or an unpainted final bar block acceptance.

material_fields: explicit trading date and time zone
model_qualification.oracle: Use fixed synthetic evidence with independently calculated answers. Test a Chinese utterance containing an alphanumeric symbol, a correction of a decimal or date, an ambiguous number, interruption during speech, cancelled tool work, a denied mutation and continuation in text. Compare the confirmed fields, resource locator, calculated value and core receipt with the fixture before scoring.
model_qualification.pass: All action-critical fields and authorization outcomes must match exactly after necessary clarification, including zero unconfirmed writes or success claims. The real text and real duplex sessions each record tested route/model/version, modality, observed timings, interruptions and costs within the approved test scope. Preserve redacted outcomes and independently record usability feedback. Mock runs, unavailable service and text fallback retain their own statuses.

observation_evidence.field_input: For a scheduled field check, retain .reports/observations/<check-id>/observation.json plus its referenced PNG files. Identify kind, commit, inputs_sha256, operator, observed_at, surface, each required action as an object with status=passed and an observed description of its actual visible outcome, and screenshot path/sha256 pairs. Current workbench observations carry observation_version 2. The Ubuntu surface is native-ubuntu-tauri-webkitgtk. Its host records os=Ubuntu, numerical ubuntu_version and webkitgtk_version, process_name=scopehub-desktop, positive process_id, window_id and matching window_process_id. The actions under FIELD_ACTIONS in scripts/verification_evidence.py cover native editing, refresh, source selection, undo, recovery and reopening. Record the observed actions in the actual window. The integrated observation also records the text, voice, CLI and desktop dispositions. The physical Windows observation additionally identifies its Windows client family, build, architecture, WebView2 and the Ubuntu-reviewed commit. Windows also exercises chart-free editing, scaling, selection, recovery and reopening. Its linked Ubuntu receipt identifies the current native observation version. Historical receipts and diagnostics describe their original observations. The same execution digest permits a bookkeeping-only commit between observations. Missing primary observations stay blocked. Include the observed Windows OS product type (1 for a client workstation) with family and build. Server builds can share a build number with a client. Hosted admission requires two independent producer declarations. Set screenshot_scope=synthetic for images captured from synthetic fixtures and sharing_scope=redacted for a text summary chosen for sharing. Hosted actions use only the versioned action names for that check. Additional local annotations or unshared summaries remain on the device. New manual observations record a timezone-aware time. Allow five minutes for clock differences when comparing the observation to the verifier’s UTC clock.
observation_evidence.session_input: A real check writes <check-id>.observation.json under SCOPEHUB_RUN_DIR, containing check, modality, commit, inputs_sha256, provider, route, data_revision, authorized_scope, observed_at and either dataset or model with deployment set to local or cloud. The configured_models summary includes both deployments; cloud_models contains only observed cloud sessions. Installation defaults are independent of either observation. Use short public or opaque aliases for provider, route, data revision, model and dataset (ASCII letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens, up to 96 characters, starting with a letter or digit). Record the scope category synthetic-model-qualification, synthetic-voice-qualification or authorized-market-verification for the respective modality. Keep URLs, account names, credentials, grant text and private values out of aliases. Exit 77 records an unavailable authorized session. A successful command without the matching observation cannot establish qualification. Model and voice observations include the redacted qualification object defined by /ai/qualified_session_acceptance/reference_case: confirmed fields, initial and corrected intervals, observed means and snapshot hashes, effects, approved annotation receipt, authorized monetary limit and actual charge. Voice also supplies measured first-audio latency, interruption, capture and follow-up outcomes. Exercise the fixed synthetic private transfer case in text and voice. Record observed completed turns, extra consent prompts and the per-stage digests of private spans sent off-device and accessible to the receiving model, and whether a later request reused the selected private context. Store only the exit code in command logs for private session, field, external-client and credential checks. Keep prompts, bodies and raw audio out of the retained observation, command output and diagnostics.
observation_evidence.candidate_input: The release check places build-manifest.json in SCOPEHUB_RUN_DIR/candidate and retains the NSIS installer there. The manifest binds commit, inputs_sha256, installer, two Windows observations, and performance by relative path and SHA-256. The owner_workbench reference retains the digest of a packaged-owner-workbench observation at observation_version 2. It binds the same commit, inputs_sha256 and installer_sha256. Manual candidate timestamps must describe completed observations, with a five-minute allowance for clock differences. This includes a performance timestamp when one is supplied. Record the observed Windows host, operator, timezone-aware observed_at, reviewer_role=product-owner, method=hands-on and concise feedback. Each of workbench-from-blank, workbench-edit, workbench-refresh and workbench-reopen records status and the actual observed outcome. Failed or partial trials can retain individually typed results. Hosted sharing requires an explicitly shareable summary marked sharing_scope=redacted. Private profiles, screenshots and raw notes can stay on the device. This review records the owner's product experience. The publication decision follows separately. Windows observations identify the host family (Windows 10/11), numerical build, x64 architecture, WebView2, operator, time, clean-install and upgrade results for the same installer hash. The performance observation binds the same source and installer, CPU, RAM, display scale, refresh rate and raw samples. Use authenticated workflow artifact retrieval for hosted evidence. Each Windows host record includes the workstation product type as well as the family and build. List packaged third-party license and notice files in third_party_licenses as relative path and SHA-256 pairs. The hosted run retains available verified installer bytes, legal notices and typed failed or partial measurements for diagnosis. Passing acceptance requires the full matching installer, manifest, Windows client observations, a complete passing owner workbench review and complete passing measurements.
